info.title: APEX Inventory API
info.description: A public-facing API for inventory managment within the APEX platform.

get.summary: Returns allowed add-on categories with configured default image URLs.
Returns add-ons for the specified event.
Returns zone statistics for the specified event.

Returns Zones' data for the specified Event for publishing purposes.
When clientVenueId is provided, each offer includes channelFees keyed by sales channel.

parameters.name: client_venue_id
parameters.description: Optional client venue for admission fee resolution (client_venue_id).

200.description: Zones data for the specified Event for publishing purposes.

get.summary: Retrieves the primary zone details for the specified event.

parameters.name: eventId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the event.

200.description: The primary zone details for the given event, or a 404 status if not found.

head.summary: Checks whether the primary zone exists for the specified event.

parameters.name: eventId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the event.

200.description: The HTTP status code indicating the result of the check. Returns 200 if the primary zone exists, 404 if not found, or 500 in case of an internal server error.
